title: CAMeL MSA frequency list (top 5000)
description: Head of the CAMeL Lab Modern Standard Arabic frequency list, derived from CAMeLBERT pretraining data (12.6 billion MSA tokens / 11.4 million types).

context.notes: CAMeL also publishes Classical, Dialectal, and mixed lists. Digits, punctuation, and non-Arabic tokens were excluded by the authors. This extract is the first 5,000 types by frequency, not the full 11.4M-type file.
